system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global tropical cyclone formation and tracking areas
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global tropical cyclone tracks covering all ocean basins including Atlantic, Pacific, Indian Ocean, and Southern Hemisphere.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Historical tropical cyclone records from 1842 to near-real-time.
data_description.temporal_unit: Individual storm events with point-based track data
data_description.records: Point features representing tropical cyclone positions along storm tracks
data_description.data_type_numeric: Storm intensity metrics including maximum sustained wind speed and minimum central pressure
data_description.total_samples: Over 13,000 tropical cyclone tracks with multiple observation points per storm
data_description.important_note: This dataset integrates tropical cyclone best track data from the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) provided by NOAA. Each feature represents a 6-hourly position observation along a storm track with associated intensity and classification information.
analytical_capabilities: Global tropical cyclone frequency and intensity trends
Storm track pattern and trajectory analysis
Extreme wind speed and pressure distribution mapping
Landfall location and coastal impact assessment
Seasonal and interannual variability in cyclone activity
Climate change impacts on tropical cyclone behavior

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Maximum sustained wind speed (knots or m/s) and minimum central pressure (mb or hPa); confirm runtime attribute schema and units before numeric analysis.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Dataset provides Saffir-Simpson scale classifications, storm names, basin identifiers, and track coordinates; includes both agency-reported and reanalysis-quality data.

data_description.data_source: NOAA International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) via Google Earth Engine
